CHAPTER 2 (CONT) Conditionally Minimum Minimum Maximum Minimum Yard Requirements Zoning District ME - RESOURCE & MINERAL EXTRACTION Purpose & Intent. The ME- Resource & Mineral Extraction District is hereby created in order that there be areas within Dudley Township exclusively reserved for the mining & extraction of mineral resources from the ground so that these activities do not adversely affect the surrounding properties, & that the land is restored to a useful condition once the minerals have been extracted from the subsurface. Zoning District FP - FLOOD PLAIN & DRAINAGEWAY Purpose & Intent.
